checks.name: scoped-report-index-exists-in-executed-schema
checks.run:
import sqlite3
from mission_control.db import SCHEMA
assert isinstance(SCHEMA,str), 'Executable schema must exist'
db=sqlite3.connect(':memory:');db.executescript(SCHEMA)
r=[x[3]for x in db.execute("EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN SELECT id FROM insight_reports WHERE app_id='one' AND source_id='selected' ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT100".replace('LIMIT100','LIMIT 100'))]
assert any('insight_report_source' in x for x in r),r
assert not any('USE TEMP B-TREE' in x for x in r),r
db.close()
